title: Latent daily review · Oct 12
tldr: No new fixes from me today. Nothing new was a clear, unfixed code bug, so I launched no Cloud Agents and made no Linear issue (Linear is also still disconnected on my side).
No age holds. Omar (@omarzz) was released Oct 11 at 10:34 AM PT, so no account is waiting to be deleted.

Two more people answered your App Store launch email asking for an Android or Play Store version: Sara ElKhabbaty and Neharika. Tridha, Radhya and mbuteler still have no reply from you, so there are 5 drafts below, oldest first.

Merged overnight, all Malcolm's: #471 (sign-in token refresh loop), #472 (stickers move and resize from anywhere), #473 (beta signups no longer email the team) and #474 (a full phone no longer cuts a long session to a 10-second clip). Malcolm's #475, #476 and #463 are still open.

In-app: 3 feature ideas. @luis wants a “close friends” sharing option, @spoon asks if early users get lifetime access (Malcolm already answered the same question by email for Sembiyan), and @arina wants to tag who you're studying with, which Malcolm's #475 is building. 24 new “Stay as a Beta Tester” picks (106 total); Malcolm handles those.

Survey unchanged (39/25/2 of 66). Sentry: 7 new one-person freezes (APPLE-IOS-6R to 6Y). PostHog: rage clicks up to 1,131 from 334 people, and 63 invite-code failures from 24 people are all “invalid code” entries, not a bug. Discord: #general-chat was busy since Oct 10 (Discord wasn't checked yesterday), mostly a birthday thread for KrabbyKai. One product question: Hujii asked if accounts are private by default, and another member, Ace, answered “private”. Nothing new in #feature-requests, #questions or #announcements; #tester-chat isn't visible.

bugs.title: Not sure if accounts are private
bugs.detail: Hujii asked on Discord how to tell if their account is private or public. A community member answered “private”; nobody from the team replied. Radhya asked a similar privacy question by email on Oct 8.

bugs.title: Group screens failing to load (PostHog group_action_failed)
bugs.detail: 139 events from 48 people in 24h (was 186/45). Mostly network errors or cancelled loads; 9 were “no group with that code”, 2 hit “permission denied for table group_invites”. No single clear code bug to hand an agent.

bugs.title: Invite codes rejected (invite_check_failed)
bugs.detail: 63 events from 24 people, up from 26/8, all with reason “invalid”, on 1.0.5. Looks like people typing wrong codes after the new launch emails, not a code bug.

bugs.title: Rage clicks doubled
bugs.detail: 1,131 rage clicks from 334 people in 24h (was 558/190). More people are using the app after the launch waves; no single screen flagged.

Hey Tridha, I'm so sorry this happened, that's a really rough way to lose a 3 week streak 😭 The age check removed accounts when the birthday came out under 13, so the wheel probably landed on the wrong year, and we've just changed it so that can't wipe an account anymore.
